property_summary: For any caller that successfully called lockInGuess and then calls settle (when block.number has advanced), the reference contract always clears that caller's stored guess.block to 0 (so a subsequent settle call will revert due to block==0); the mutant fails to clear guess.block and therefore allows a subsequent settle call to proceed for some inputs.
change_summary: Remove resetting of guesses[msg.sender].block to 0 (so block remains set after settle), changing subsequent observable behavior.
